comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record zeros a dial indicator without disturbing its measurement setup.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert and pull under latch contact versus rotate a bezel delicately while holding plunger displacement nearly constant.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires terminal removal without collateral damage and lacks numeric force/damage thresholds. Record requires pointer/zero alignment within divisions, hands off, stillness, and plunger disturbance below 0.02 mm.
comparison.reason: Both demand fine manipulation, but the record tests non-disturbing calibration rather than constrained release.
